title: STEPS: Scene Text Editing with Preserved Style Using Diffusion and Contrastive Style Encoding
abstract: arXiv:2609.38636v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce Scene Text Editing with Preserved Style (STEPS), a novel diffusion model architecture for quality text replacement in images. Scene Text Editing (STE), also known as Visual Text Editing, consists of changing the textual content in an image while conserving the original style, e.g. font, colors, orientation, background, etc. STEPS advances the state of the art in STE through directed focus on improved style preservation. We introduce a style encoder for visual text that captures style independently of textual content, and a model architecture that combines the style encoder with multiple semantic conditions (target text characters encoding and rendered glyphs). STEPS achieves superior results to previous STE methods in style preservation, output readability, and subjective quality.

translated_title: STEPS：基于扩散模型与对比式风格编码的风格保持场景文本编辑
translated_abstract: 我们提出了风格保持的场景文本编辑方法（STEPS），这是一种用于图像中高质量文本替换的新型扩散模型架构。场景文本编辑（STE），也称为视觉文本编辑，其任务是在保持图像原始风格（如字体、颜色、方向、背景等）的前提下更改图像中的文本内容。STEPS 通过专注于改进风格保持，推动了场景文本编辑领域的技术水平。我们引入了一个针对视觉文本的风格编码器，它能够独立于文本内容来捕获风格信息，并设计了一种将风格编码器与多种语义条件（目标文本字符编码和渲染字形）相结合的模型架构。STEPS 在风格保持、输出可读性和主观质量方面均超越了以往的 STE 方法。
tldr: STEPS 提出了一种结合扩散模型、独立于文本内容的对比式风格编码器与多重语义条件的场景文本编辑架构，在保持原始风格的同时实现高质量的图像文字替换，并在风格保持、可读性和主观质量上超越以往方法。
en_tdlr: STEPS is a novel diffusion-based scene text editing architecture that combines a content-independent contrastive style encoder with multiple semantic conditions, achieving superior style-preserving text replacement in images compared to prior methods.
